structural_change: ECTLA-2 2026-10-17 (coordinator 0co (1): k1 qkd_static_ectla_kiss REJECTED at review: TT clock insertion 350 ps, W landing face 1,100 pins at 8.5/um, SRAMs off the 43.2 lattice in x, two std-cell bands). Structural re-plan, same child RTL and cycles (ROW_RETURN_LAT = RESPONSE_LAT + 7): outline re-aspected inside the KV die's ECTL slot to 172.8 x 194.4 (4 x 4.5 lattice; the tile is pin-limited: 2.1k um2 std + 7.8k um2 SRAM); both SRAMs stacked in ONE column on the lattice (x 43.2, y 43.2 / 129.6) with their pin edge (W) facing ONE contiguous std-cell band (landing capture, issuer, ECTL body); the E strip carries only the rs_o / x_i pin flops; W landing 1,100 pins over 190 um (5.8/um, M4 + M6); E rs_o / x_i at the grant's exact y (B abuts bottom-aligned); t0_row (S) / t1_row (N) over x 23..170 (3.5/um). Clock: symmetric insertion-aware spine from ck at the N-face centre (x 86), leaves of 24 sinks and leaf-only balancing pads (OT_SPINE_LEAF_N 24, OT_SPINE_TREE_PAD 0: the in-tree pads of k1 raised every branch to the slowest; measured gate sweep on this outline: k1 knobs 324 ps, LEAF_N 16 338 ps, LEAF_N 16 + fan 16 412 ps, LEAF_N 24 + leaf pads 279 ps / spread 31 ps; k2 216x216 TritonCTS 388 / 123). | ECTLA-3 2026-10-17 (FLOW-HOLD): r3-32e20b9e0 NEEDS_RTL, FF hold -76.5, stall class I2R=3 rst_n -> u.u.u_rpin sync/relay RESETN (removal -81 ps) after 1,104 inhold + 1,574 outhold pin pads and 7,923 CTS hold buffers. Recipe 3 -> 4 with hold_budget die: no pin hold pads (inhold/outhold off, hold_pad removed, io_hold_margin 0), boundary hold is the die's. RTL made flop-first at the three remaining pins: rst_n -> pin flop rst_q -> ECTL A reset relay (the body releases one edge later); rsp_valid / rsp_v land only on rv_q / vv_q and rs[0] = rv_q && !vv_q (bit-identical). Outline, macros, pins, clock unchanged.

slot_change_request: ECTLA-2 2026-10-17: ECTL A slot re-aspected 254.88 x 129.6 -> 172.8 x 194.4 inside the KV die's ECTL area (KV has spare area; re-grant only): A's bottom edge aligns with B so rs_o/x_i keep their y; t0_row/t1_row leave over x 23..170 (the head-tile pair row pins re-map), landing req/rsp on the W face over 190 um. Exact pins: results/arch/qwen_kv_static_ectla2_1017/qkd_static_ectla_k3.tcl.

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every data pin (FLOW-HOLD recipe 4, hold_budget die; ECTLA-3 2026-10-17): routed r3-32e20b9e0 netlist audit -- 1,103 input bits land only on flop D pins, 37 unused, the 1,573 driven outputs leave a flop Q/QN(+INV); the last three non-flop-first inputs are fixed in RTL: rsp_valid / rsp_v (issuer rs[0] = rv_q && !vv_q, bit-identical) and rst_n (ECTL A body reset relay fed by the pin flop rst_q). A synthesis pin register (+1 edge per port) would shift the ECTL static calendar (QK_ISSUE_AGE, ROW_RETURN_LAT, HXK count every boundary edge in the RTL).
